title: The Three Cosmic Ages
description: The whole of regeneration unfolds in three structural periods, running from the moment the Lord's life first comes forth and is met by what the soul has claimed, until everything that received light has been sifted and made clean. The first period: the divine humanity comes down into the depths of the natural and contends with the proprium, prevailing yet remaining for a time below in the natural worlds, until the operative power lifts it home. The second period: the natural mind is given its structure, set on its feet, ordered and held until the call may be sent into it. The third period: the call is sent into the prepared natural, the Lord's image is revealed, the truth chooses out the light, and the great gathering brings the work to its peace.
